definitions: Move to a specified location or position.
Bring into a particular state or condition.
Express something in a particular way.
Impose a task, burden, or responsibility on someone.
Place a bet or make an investment.
examples: She put the book on the table.
The news put him in a bad mood.
How would you put that into words?
They put a lot of pressure on us.
He put all his savings into the venture.
